ana: Quick follow-up from the recent outage. We need to convert the postmortem fixes into tests and a short chaos runbook. Proposed owners below.

ana: Proposed items:
- regression prompt set covering streaming drop + corrupted partials (owner: mike)
- lightweight CI eval job for PRs touching serving/ (owner: gina + eng-platform)
- k6 load replay for the KV spike pattern (owner: tariq)
- 1x targeted chaos drill for canary and autoscale (owner: ana)
- dashboard + alert for prompt regressions (owner: gina)

mike: I can own the prompt set. I'll add 6 curated prompts to ml/evals/regressions/incident_172555 with golden artifacts and mark nondeterministic tokens. ETA 2026-04-04.

gina: I'll wire the CI eval job and dashboard panels. For alerts let's use eval_pass_rate with a 5% drop threshold over 24h. ETA 2026-04-06.

tariq: I'll produce scripts/k6/kv_replay.js that mimics a 3m spike + 4m taper. Will add a nightly staging run and a weekly canary run. ETA 2026-04-07. Need a 20m validation window in staging after CI.

sre-bot: Reminder: attach incident trace to the postmortem doc to improve fidelity for load payloads.

ana: Action recap I'll add to the postmortem checklist:
- mike: regression prompts + PR (due 2026-04-04)
- gina: CI eval job + dashboards + alerts (due 2026-04-06)
- tariq: k6 replay + CI job (due 2026-04-07)
- ana: chaos drill planning (propose date by 2026-04-08)

mike: Confirmed. I'll include prompt IDs for gina to wire alerts.

gina: Confirmed. Will coordinate with eng-platform for incremental short-run gating (first 5 prompts) and nightly full run.

tariq: Confirmed. Requesting staging slot on 2026-04-08 14:00 UTC for validation.

ana: Thanks all. I'll create GH issues and schedule a weekly 30m check-in until closed. :white_check_mark:
